verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a Management API with authentication (API keys/personal access tokens), SDK methods to trigger, wait, check status, cancel and retry tasks (trigger-dev-docs-15/16/23/24/27/33), giving AI-native users a programmatic surface beyond the UI. However, probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all candidate paths 404, trigger-dev-probe-3) and no docs.md endpoint, meaning the API isn't machine-readable in a standard schema format despite good prose docs and an llms.txt file. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/schema spec, independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness beyond SDK docs.
